1.o: في القرن الثالث عشر الميلادي، يتم بيع أفراد من أسر قبائل التركمان في أسوق الدولة العباسية كعبيد من ضمنهم الظاهر بيبرس، ويطلب فخر الدين من علاء الدين تحصين مدينته خوفًا من مخطط إسماعيل بالإنقلاب عليه وعلى السلطان.

2.o: يتم بيع بيبرس إلى الأمير علاء الدين أيدكين البندقداري، ويتم تعيين فارس في قيادة جيش السلطان ضد إسماعيل، ويبحث داود وإسماعيل خطة القضاء على جيش فارس.

3.o: تزداد مكانة بيبرس ويصبح من أهم المستشارلين لعلاء الدين على الرغم من كونه عبد، ويشترط ريتشارد على الصالح إسماعيل الحصول على القدس في حالة التحالف معه في الحرب ضد السلطان.

4.o: تتقهقر جيوش إسماعيل أمام جيش نجم الدين أيوب، فيأمر الأخير - فارس بالذهاب إلى دمشق والقبض على إسماعيل، فينجح الأمر ويساق إسماعيل إلى نجم الدين أسيرًا، ويتم عزل علاء الدين من نجم الدين ويُقبض على بيبرس ويُرحل إلى القاهرة.

5.o: يصل بيبرس إلى القاهرة أسيرًا، ويتبارز مع قطز أمام الملك الصالح نجم الدين ليُثبت له قوة بيبرس وضرورة ضمه في الجيش.

6.o: خلال الحرب بين المسلمين والصليبيين، يموت الملك الصالح نجم الدين أيوب، ويستمر زحف الجيش الفرنجي إلى المنصورة، ويقرر قطز إخفاء أمر موت نجم الدين خوفًا على عزيمة الجيش.

7.o: يتم تعيين توران شاه محل نجم الدين، بينما يصبح بيبرس أميرًا لجيش من جيوش السلطان، ويشعر قطز بالقلق من تواطئ توران شاه مع جنود الفرنجة.

8.o: يهجم بيبرس وقلاوون الصالحي لقتل توران شاه فيموت الأخير، وتتولى شجرة الدر عرش مصر بعد توران شاه، ويحذر بيبرس - شجرة الدر من ثورة بسبب تولي امرأة عرش مصر، وتتزوج من عز الدين أيبك وتتنازل له عن السلطنة.

9.o: يُعلن الناصر يوسف ملك حلب الحرب على عز الدين أيبك وشجرة الدر، ويحاول أقطاي تحذير عز الدين من سيطرة شجرة الدر عليه.

10.o: يأمر عز الدين أيبك - قطز بقتل فخر الدين بتهمة التأمر عليه، ويطلب الناصر يوسف مساعدة بيبرس في القضاء على عز الدين أيبك، ويتفاجئ عز الدين أيبك بمطالب الصلح من الناصر يوسف.

11.o: مع توغل التتار في سمرقند واقترابهم من الشام، يعترض بيبرس على رغبة الناصر يوسف بإرسال بعثة لقائد التتار وعقد هدنة، وتقتل شجرة الدر - عز الدين أيبك، وتحاول إخفاء فعلتها بترشيحها لقطز بالحكم.

12.o: يرفض قطز تولي الحكم بقيادة شجرة الدر في الخلفية، فيتم اختيار علي بن عز الدين خليفة لوالده، بينما يصبح قطز نائبًا له والخليفة الشرعي لعلي، وتبدأ الوقيعة من الحاشية بين علي وقطز، بينما يتم قتل شجرة الدر.

13.o: يخشى قطز من تدبير بيبرس لمؤامرة في الشام للزحف لمصر وقتله بسبب طرده له وقتل أقطاي، ويصبح الثنائي على وشك مواجهة محتملة، بينما يوطد الناصر يوسف علاقته بجيش هولاكو.

14.o: يندم قطز على طرده لبيبرس وقتله لأقطاي، ويعرض أمير المؤمنين المستعصم على هولاكو تسليمه بغداد وعقد معاهدة بينهما، فينقلب هولاكو عليه ويأمر بوضعه داخل جلد بقر وضربه حتى الموت.

15.o: يرفض بيبرس وقطز مبارزة بعضهما البعض فيقرر بيبرس الانسحاب من المعركة، ويأمر قطز بمباركة علي بإعدام كل أسرى الكرد، ويتقابل بيبرس مع حبيبته رقية بعد سنوات من البحث عنها.

16.o: يستمر حصار هولاكو لدمشق لأكثر من ثمانية أشهر دون قدرته على اقتحامها، وينفذ بيبرس عمليات فردية يدمر من خلالها أسلحة جيش هولاكو وينجح في قتل أكثر من 100 جندي وحيدًا.

17.o: يعد بيبرس - رقية بالزواج ويأمر الخدم برعايتها في غيابه، ويقسم هولاكو جيشه لثلاثة أقطار لإسقاط دمشق، ويدعو قطز العامة والجيش لخلع علي وتولي منصب السلطان بدلًا منه ونجح الأمر.

18.o: يرفض بيبرس الذهاب وعقد صلح مع هولاكو، وتزداد شعبية قطز في منصب السلطان، بينما يجهز بيبرس للمواجهة المحتملة مع جيش التتار في سعيهم لدخول دمشق.

19.o: يتم العثور على رقية مقتولة في مخدع يوسف فيقرر بيبرس الانتقام، فيُقنعه بعدم قتله لرقية ويتهم زين الدين بتدبير وقيعة بينهما.

20.o: يُرسل بيبرس إلى قطز رغبة منه في استضافته بجيشه في مصر فيوافق، ويحاول الناصر يوسف قتل نفسه فيُنقذه الطبيب، ويلتقي قطز وبيبرس بعد سنوات من الوقيعة بينهما.

21.o: يقع الناصر يوسف أسيرًا في يد كاتبغا فينجح في سرقة أحد سيوف الحراس ويقتل نفسه، ويرسل هولاكو خطابًا لقطز يهدده ويأمره بالاستسلام أمام جيش التتار.

22.o: يأمر هولاكو - كاتبغا بالزحف نحو القاهرة والقضاء على قطز وجيشه، فيخطط قطز وبيبرس لاستدراج جيش هولاكو لمنطقة عين جالوت والقضاء على جيشهم، وينجح بيبرس بإسقاط جيش كاتبغا وقتله.

23.o: يضع هولاكو ابنه على رأس جيش من 2000 فارس للهجوم على جيش قطز والانتقام، ويحذر فارس الدين - قطز من بيبرس ويطلب منه إرضائه.

24.o: يحاول قطز كسب ود بيبرس الذي لم ينسى قتله لأقطاي من خلال إعطائه حكم حلب بعد الانتهاء من الحرب ضد هولاكو، وتقع معركة بين بيبرس وبعض المماليك وبين قطز فيموت الأخير.

25.o: يتم مبايعة بيبرس سلطانًا على مصر والشام بعد مقتل قطز، ويرفض هولاكو الاستماع لابنته طوكوز ويصر على الهجوم على جيش بيبرس وقتله، ويتم تعيين سيف الدين قلاوون قائدًا للعسكر في مصر، وفارس الدين أقطاي (المستعرب) نائبًا لبيبرس.

26.o: يُجهز بيبرس وسيف الدين قلاوون للزحف بجيشهما ومواجهة جيش ابن هولاكو، فينجح بيبرس بالانتصار مجددًا، ويعرض بركة خان ابن عم هولاكو التحالف مع بيبرس والمماليك.

27.o: يُجهز بيبرس جيشه لغزو بيروت في حالة رفض حاكمتها إيزابيلا بالخضوع له، ويتولى أباقا خان جيش التتار بعد وفاة هولاكو، ويتزوج بيبرس من تورخان.

28.o: تلجئ امرأة مسكينة لبيبرس لتطلب منه تحرير ابنتها التي اختطفها الفرنجة وإيزابيلا، ويتحالف أورلاندو وأباقا مع إيزابيلا للتصدي لبيبرس، وينجح الأخير في تحرير الفتاة.

29.o: يبدأ بيبرس الزحف بجيشه لبيروت، وينجح في الانتصار لتسقط إيزابيلا أسيرة في يده، وتمر السنوات فيُنجب بيبرس ابنه السعيد بركة.

30.o: سلسلة من اللقطات المجمعة التي تستعرض كل الحكام الذين حكموا، وصولًا إلى بيبرس والذي انتهت قصته بقتله أثناء قضائه بعض الوقت مع ابنه الصغير.

1.o: يتنازل العم، الملك "جوليان"، عن عرشه ويسلّم تاجه للأمير "جوليان"... فليبدأ عهد الملك "جوليان" الثالث عشر!

2.o: يكتشف الملك "جوليان" أن 99 في المائة من حيوانات الليمور تُحبّه... لذا يجعل مهمته العثور على "كارهه" الوحيد وتغيير رأيه.

3.o: يعتزم العبقري الشرير "كارل" تدمير الملك "جوليان". وحين يقع "كلوفر" و"موريس" في الأسر، يتعيّن على الملك إنقاذهما من عدوه اللدود الجديد.

4.o: بعد أن أنهكه حل نزاعات رعاياه، يستبدل الملك "جوليان" نفسه بدمية وهمية ليتهرب من واجباته الملكية، مما يؤدي لإشعال فتيل تمرّد عن غير قصد.

5.o: عازمًا على استرداد عرشه، يقوم الملك العم بإقناع "جوليان" بالذهاب إلى مقاطعة "فوسا"، إ يصنع قناعًا تنكريًا ويجبر "موريس" للانضمام إليه.

6.o: تُضطر "كلوفر" إلى أخذ عطلة. وبينما تكون في الخارج، تلتقي بـ "سيج مووندانسر" الوسيم والمفعم بالحماسة.

7.o: ينضم "جوليان" إلى التنريق "تيمو"، وهو عالِم يستعين به الملك لجعل كل شيء في المملكة يعمل أوتوماتيكيًا.

8.o: يحاول "جوليان" تعويض تجاوزه في حق "موريس" بعد إحراجه له، بينما ينضم "مورت" عن غير قصدٍ إلى مجموعة مناهضة للملك "جوليان".

9.o: ينسج "جوليان" كذبة معقدة بإلقاء اللوم على "برص عملاق" في تدمير حفل عيد ميلاد ليمورٍ صغيرٍ.

10.o: يعثر "جوليان" على حقيبة من حبوب القهوة في "كهف العجائب"، ويجعل مجتمع الليمور كله يُدمن على تناول الكافيين.

1.o: لدى الملك "جوليان" فكرة رائعة: سيروض حيوان فوسا ويدربه للحفاظ على السلام في مملكته، لكن تأتي الرياح بما لا تشتهي السفن.

2.o: يثير "جوليان" جنونًا بالموضة عندما يحوّل صندوقًا من الحفاضات إلى أكثر الأزياء التي رأتها المملكة أناقةً.

3.o: يقع "جوليان" في الحبّ من النظرة الأولى بعد لقائه بشقيقة "كلوفر"، "كريمزون"... فهل يمكن أن يكون الملك قد وجد ملِكته؟

4.o: عندما ينخدع "جوليان" ويصدّق أن "ثمرة أناناس مقدسة" تحتوي على حكمة الملوك السابقين، يحاول "مورت" الحسود التخلّص منها.

5.o: بعد انبهاره بفكرة المال، يجلب الملك "جوليان" النقود إلى المملكة، لكن مهارات "مورت" المُة في المال تثير مشاكل كبيرة.

6.o: عندما يُصاب بديل الملك "جوليان" في المزلقة المائية، يقع على كاهل "ماجيك ستيف" عقد محادثات سلام مع التماسيح الغاضبة.

7.o: ينقذ "جوليان" ليمورًا عجوزًا لطيفًا يُسمى "دوك شوغرفوت" من كهف ويأخذه كمستشارٍ له.

8.o: ظنًا منه أن "مورت" هو ابنه، يُعيد "جوليان" تسميته بـ "فالكون" ويُشركه في مهرجان "السيد الشاب"، لكنه يجهل الكثير عن عمر الليمور الحقيقي.

9.o: يظهر "روب"، أفضل الأصدقاء السابقين للملك "جوليان"، وشريكه في أغنية الراب "يحب الليمور أنثاه" ليستدرج الملك مجدّدًا إلى الحفلات الصاخبة.

10.t: The Man in the Iron Booty
10.o: يتنازل "جوليان" عن مملكته لمساعدة زميلٍ ملكي له واقع في محنة، ليكتشف أنه تمّ خداعه بواسطة عدوين قديمين.

11.o: بعد انطلاقه في رحلة للاستيلاء على القمر لأجل حيوانات الليمور جميعها، يلتقي الملك "جوليان" وجهًا لوجه مع "ستانيسلاف"، قرد الفضاء الروسي.

12.o: حين يكتشف "جوليان" أن "موريس" يعمل إضافيًا كمستشار لملك الفئران "جوي"، يختصم أفضل صديقين ويطلبان المشورة من ثمرة الأناناس المقدسة.

13.t: The King Who Would Be King
13.o: أثناء كتابة قصة حياة "جوليان"، تختلق "كلوفر" حكاية عن عقرب عملاق يلتهم الأطفال يُسمى "فريد"، ثم يقرأها "فريد" الحقيقي ويتعهد بالانتقام.

14.t: Are You There, Frank? It's me, King Julien
14.ar: هل أنت هناك يا "فرانك"؟ هذا أنا، الملك "جوليان"
14.o: بعد طلب ملك السماء "فرانك" من الليمور التضحية بالملك "جوليان"، يخترع "جوليان" إلهًا خاصًا به: "لاري" إله البراكين.

15.o: يتحقّق أخيرًا حلم "جوليان" بافتتاح نادٍ ليلي، لكن المكان يسكنه شبح مُقنّع... أو يمكن أن يكون شخصًا يتعمّد الأذى؟

16.o: يتمّ تشخيص إصابة "جوليان" بمرض الحصان المجنون، لكنه يرفض التخلي عن العرش لعمه دون قتالٍ... أو ربما سباق حواجز.

1.o: "جوليان" مفقود ومخزون المانجو آخذ في النقصان، والحياة في القرية لا يمكن أن تصبح أكثر جنونًا... إلى أن يصل والدا "جوليان" المزعجين للغاية.

2.o: تسارع "كلوفر" و"مورت" لإنقاذ الملك "جوليان" الذي يحاول الإفلات من عقوبة الإعدام على خشبة القراصنة باستعراض رقصته "القرصان المُجند" الأصلية.

3.o: بينما يهمّ والداه بالرحيل، يحاول "جوليان" استعادة طفولته بأن يُجبرهما على حضور طقس الحفل الراقص الذي فاتهما حضوره في طفولته.

4.o: عندما يحقق والداه أمنيته في أن يكون له أخ عبر تبنّي "برودني" المنعزل، تنتاب "جوليان" حماسة عارمة ويهيئ لـ"برودني" حياة تليق بالملوك.

5.o: ينتاب "جوليان" الفزع حين يُعلن والداه أنهما لن يُغادرا أبدًا، فيخطط لإرعابهما... لكن ينقلب السحر على الساحر حين يتمادى "كارل" في تنفيذها.

6.o: يراهن "جوليان" بقدرة فريقه الرياضي هزيمة فريق الملك العم "جوليان"، ويخاطر بمصير المملكة كلها... المشكلة الوحيدة أن نجم "جوليان" الرياضي خفت.

7.t: Close Encounters of the Mort Kind
7.o: يختطف الفضائيون "مورت" مِرارًا مستحثين غيرة "جوليان"، فهل يمكن لـ"كلوفر" وبقية الرفاق مساعدة الملك في مقابلة الفضائيين شخصيًا قبل بدء الغزو؟

8.o: لرفع روح المملكة الوطنية، يُعلن "جوليان" حربًا مزيفة على الفراشات... لكن يُختبر كبرياؤه حين تبادله الفراشات العداء وتهاجمه بالفعل.

9.ar: مسابقة الطعام السريع، يا شعب الليمور
9.o: رغبةً منه في جلب إدخال الأطعمة السريعة إلى مملكته، يقيم "جوليان" مسابقة للأفكار... ولكن هل سيكون الفوز نعمة على الألسن أم نقمة على الطبخ؟

10.o: "جوليان" يملؤه اليقين من أن فولته القافزة المحبوبة قد سُرقت فيصبح مهووسًا بالأمن... وليُثير حفيظة "كلوفر"، يُسلّح القرية بالعقارب.

11.o: يجد "جوليان" في حفل جمع شمل طلاب مدرسة الليمور فرصة ذهبية ليعيش أيام مجده من جديد، لكن معشوقته "كارين" وخصمه "كارل" يضمران مخططًا مختلفًا.

12.o: يتعين على "كلوفر" الاختيار ما بين الواجب الملكي وكبرياء العائلة بعد دعوتها إلى خوض "بطولة الهالكين" ومنع "جوليان" إياها من المشاركة فيها.

13.o: بعد أن أدّت معاهدة السلام إلى انعدام الاستقرار وتدمير جهاز التسجيل... يقرر "جوليان" بناء جدار يحجب غير قرود الليمور عن مملكة الحفلات.

1.t: The All Hail King Julien Show
1.o: بعد أن أصابته أنباء "جي جي" بالملل، يُعلن "جوليان" عن تشكيلة من البرامج الجديدة تقود المملكة بأكملها نحو نوبة جنونية.

2.o: بعد إصابتها في رأسها، تعتقد "كلوفر" أنها إحدى شخصيات قصص المغامرات التي تحبها... وعلى الباقين مجاراتها لإنقاذها من مصير مُريع.

3.o: تُشعل لوحة مدهشة رسمها "مورت" المملكة بأسرها... الأمر الذي يفسد خطط "جوليان" ليصبح الرسام الأعظم المُقبل في المملكة.

4.o: بعد تحذير "ماسيكورا" من اقتراب غرق الجزيرة، يسارع "جوليان" باحثًا عن طريقة لمغادرتها، بينما يبحث "موريس" و"كلوفر" عن لعبته في أنحاء المملكة.

5.o: بعد تخليص المملكة من ديك الأدغال المزعج، يشعر الملك "جوليان" بتأنيب الضمير ويقرّر الانطلاق في مهمة إنقاذ.

6.o: يقرر الملك "جوليان" إقامة حفل تعارف مستوحًى من كتاب عن الآداب الأرستقراطية... لكن مدرّبه على تلك الآداب يتمادى كثيرًا في توجيهاته.

7.o: بعد مرض "جوليان" وذهاب الآخرين في رحلة بحرية، ينتحل "مورت" شخصية الملك للترفيه عن أحد الحكام في مسابقة مهمة... وهو ما يؤدي إلى نتائج كارثية.

8.o: تُحوّل لمسة "تيمو" السحرية فرقة الملك "جوليان" غير المتناغمة إلى فرقة مشهورة في عالم موسيقى البوب... لكن هذا التغيير لا يروق للجميع.

9.o: عندما يُشغل الملك "جوليان" شريطًا غامضًا في جهاز التسجيل لديه، تُنشط الأصوات الغريبة عميلًا سريًا كان عمّه قد أجرى له غسيل دماغ ومحا ذاكرته.

10.o: يتسبب خطأ فني في آلة الاستنساخ الجديدة الخاصة بـ"جوليان" في انطلاق جيش من "مورت" الغاضب بقيادة طاغية صغير... وحتى "تيمو" لا يعرف كيف يردعهم!

11.o: يصادق الملك "جوليان"، خلال إحدى المغامرات الليلية الجامحة، محاربًا وحيدًا يُدعى"كوتو"... والذي يُثير مشاعر قوية في المملكة.

12.o: بعد اكتشافه لأمرٍ صادم، ينطلق "موريس" في رحلة للعثور على مصيره الحقيقي. وفي الوقت نفسه، يختبر "جوليان" ما ستكون عليه الحياة دون "مومو".

13.o: بينما تقترب قرود الجبال أكثر فأكثر، يتحدّى "جوليان" صديقه السابق "كوتو" في مسابقة رقص أسطورية يتربّع الفائز فيها على عرش المملكة.

1.o: Nao moves into her own apartment, but a male classmate shows up and says he's the real tenant. They find a solution but it won't be easy to pull off.

2.o: Nao is still reeling from the morning's events but Uehara doesn't remember a thing. Marina suspects something is up and starts asking questions.

3.o: Nao tends to Hisashi, who is hospitalized from overworking. A mysterious woman appears. Rumors buzz at school that Hisashi and Nao are an item.

4.o: With Christmas Eve fast approaching, an unfortunate encounter with a delivery boy leads Nao to a new job, where she meets Abe, the "confession king."

5.o: A confession to Abe confuses Nao's relationship with Uehara further. Later, she hears that he'll be spending New Year's with his coworker, Nanako.

6.t: Faking Up is Hard to Do
6.o: At Marina's suggestion, Nao and Uehara eat lunch bento together in public. It's fun, but she wonders if he's thinking of Yuri when they're together.

7.o: Yuri announces she's getting divorced and asks to stay at the apartment. Uehara goes home to his brother, leaving Yuri and Nao to live alone together.

8.t: He's Not Sexy, He's My Brother
8.o: Uehara's older brother, Takuya, tries to explain himself, but Yuri isn't having it and throws away her wedding ring. Nao works to help them reconcile.

9.o: Nao overhears Uehara talking about his feelings for her. Too flummoxed to respond, she avoids him. Marina suggests a Valentine's Day date.

10.o: Nao finds out Yuri stayed overnight and announces she'll be moving out. Daichi calls Uehara to a one-on-one meeting on the school rooftop.

11.o: The parents find out the truth and Uehara leaves to live at home. When her father cancels the contract, Nao runs away and Uehara goes to face him.

12.o: In an effort to rebuff Yukari's overtures, Icchan claims Nao is his girlfriend. Uehara overhears, but his lack of a reaction worries Nao.

13.o: Transfer student Nozomi Kitaura confronts Nao on the rooftop and shares her feelings about Uehara. Worried, Nao plans a special date with him.

14.o: Uehara’s presence alone puts Nao on cloud nine, but Issei throws her looks with mixed feelings. By chance, Nao is paired with Issei for a dare night.

15.o: After the trip, Nao is hospitalized for food poisoning and meets a kind college student. She learns that Uehara has been having a cute girl over.

16.o: Issei has moved into the apartment after a family fight. Marina has her eye on a visiting college student, whom Nao recognizes from the hospital.

17.o: Nao mistakenly assumes Uehara will propose to her, and engagement rumors spread throughout the school. After he denies it to her face, she collapses.

1.t: Campus Life Is Full of Temptation
1.o: Nao and Uehara head off to college, but Uehara's popularity worries Nao, and their new acquaintance Natsume seems to want to separate them.

2.o: A kiss incident with Natsume causes misunderstandings between Uehara and Nao. He takes a job in a lab while she scopes out clubs at college.

3.o: Nao learns that Uehara is on first name terms with Saeko in his lab. She confides her fears to Natsume during a trip to a petting zoo with his sister.

4.o: With Uehara's birthday approaching, Nao takes a job at the store where Natsume works. A customer's request makes them both think about what they want.

5.o: Natsume and Nao take lead roles in Abecchi's play, but the script's kiss scenes annoy Uehara. Meanwhile, Micchan and Marina are on the rocks.

6.o: Nao plans a surprise party for Uehara's birthday, but unbeknownst to her, he quickly finds out about it. Natsume gives Nao some advice.

7.o: Uehara suspects Natsume has feelings for Nao. Natsume confides in Saeko, and Nanase and Nao discuss love while working on a project.

8.o: Nao doesn't tell Uehara that Natsume kissed her, but he figures it out. Nao, Natsume and the group go camping while Uehara and Saeko attend a lecture.

9.t: Can You Fall Out of Love?
9.o: Nao stresses out after Uehara tells her he wants some space. Worrying about her, Natsume punches Uehara, then tells Nao how he feels.

10.t: Give Me a Good Morning Call Tomorrow
10.o: Uehara and Nao have broken up, and Nao is trying to reinvent herself. She hopes they'll get back together, but Saeko's feelings haven't changed.

1.o: After spending their first year of high school in peace and quiet, Haruka and Makoto run into Nagisa, a new student who was a member at a swimming club with them when they were kids.  That swimming club is being torn down, so the three of them sneak in to dig up a time capsule that they buried in the back, which is when they are reunited with Rin, the fourth member of their group who left to study abroad.

2.o: Makoto and Nagisa watch with their breaths held as Haruka and Rin engage in an intense race.  However, they notice that Rin appears to be have changed. At the same time, Nagisa prepares to start up a swim club with help from Rin's sister Gou.

3.o: The Iwatobi Swim Club needs one more member before it can participate in relays.  Nagisa has set his sights on his classmate Rei, who is a member of the track team.  Despite Rei's refusal to join, but Nagisa appears intent on recruiting Rei into the swim club.

4.o: The Iwatobi Swim Club has a full roster now.As they begin to practice, they run into a little trouble.After a certain member claims that his swimsuit is to blame, the club makes a trip to buy new swimsuits.

5.o: Haruka and the other club members decide to hold a training camp to prepare for prefectural.  Each member follows his own regimen.  However, Rei is unhappy about falling behind and heads back into the ocean at night to practice.

6.o: There's trouble at the beach.  The four swim club members are forced to revisit their motivation to swim.  After Rei asks Makoto about his odd behavior during the training camp, Makoto tells them about his past.

7.o: As prefecturals draw near, Haruka and the other swim club members continue to improve.  Meanwhile, Rin reveals his motivations for swimming.  The swimmers must now show what they have accomplished at the tournament.

8.o: Haruka, Makoto, Nagisa, and Rei swim in their individual events.  Rin becomes irritated as he remembers watching them swim back in grade school.  Afterwards, the four Iwatobi Swim Club members must prepare for the medley relay.

9.o: Prefecturals are over and the Iwatobi Swim Club members are pleased by the progress they have made.  A local summer festival gives them an opportunity to relax.  When Nagisa finds out that Rin is also at the festival, he orders Rei to follow Rin and make sure that Haruka and Rin do not meet.

10.o: Coach Sasabe begins training the Iwatobi Swim Club for the upcoming tournament. Meanwhile, Rei is unhappy about the fact that he's the only one who doesn't know about what happened with Rin in the past.  After Rin expresses his frustration, Haruka decides to tell him about what happened when they were in grade school.

11.o: After hearing about what happened in the past, Rei goes to Samezuka Academy to ask Rin what he wants. The night before Iwatobi and Samezuka leave for regionals, Rin calls Rei to explain how he feels about the relay. And then, Samezuka announces its lineup for the relay.

12.o: The Iwatobi Swim Club must win to advance to nationals. As the tournament draws near, the members get nervous. Meanwhile, Rin grows increasingly irritated. As it comes time for the medley relay, each member must find their own answer as they step up to the start line

1.o: Haruka and his friends have grown after last summer’s tournament. Amidst the hustle and bustle of training for their individual events, their daily lives continue as usual. However, a new season now approaches!

2.o: The crew ponders how to attract new members to the Swim Club. Haruka is called in by Amakata-sensei to discuss his intended career path, but as always, Haruka moves to the beat of his own drum. Meanwhile, Coach Sasabe brings an interesting opportunity to the boys…

3.o: The Iwatobi Festival has begun! Haruka and friends are fired up for the Club-versus-Club Relay Race, hoping to attract new members by putting in an impressive performance. Meanwhile, Rei begins training but is worried by the fact that he can still only swim the butterfly stroke…

4.o: In anticipation of the upcoming prefectural tournament, the members of the Samezuka Swim Club enthusiastically show off their individual abilities. At the Iwatobi Swim Club, an equally enthusiastic Gou proposes a lunchbox inspection to ensure the boys are getting the right nutrition to support their training. However...

5.o: The members of the Iwatobi Swim Club ponder over the cause of Nagisa’s odd behavior at the end of practice that day. Though they time their chance well to ask Nagisa what’s happened, Nagisa stubbornly refuses to explain why he’s upset...

6.o: On the eve of prefecturals, Makoto resolves himself to broach a certain subject with Haruka. As the tournament begins, the Iwatobi Swim Club is extremely enthusiastic about its prospects. But will every member be able to pass the prelims of his individual events?

7.o: Haruka and the boys have trained hard to prepare for this showdown against Samezuka. After Day 1 of the tournament, Gou and Amakata-sensei treat the boys to a fabulous, carb-rich feast and allow them to take a breather. Meanwhile, Rin is faced with a tough decision as captain of the Samezuka Swim Club. Who will he choose to swim the relay with him?

8.o: While Haruka and the boys redouble their training in the wake of prefecturals, Makoto notices Gou looking troubled and asks her what’s wrong. She tells him that Coach Sasabe has been so busy with his Swim Club lately, he hasn’t been by to approve their new training regimen. Makoto offers to go see him for her, but what he finds at the Swim Club is...

9.o: At Samezuka Academy, the hot-blooded practices continue ahead of regionals. Meanwhile, the Iwatobi Swim Club trains diligently each day until sundown. Though Amakata-sensei is concerned, Haruka and the boys insist they want to practice as much as possible before the tournament.

10.o: As the tournament continues, Sousuke finally tells Rin about how he’s passed their years of separation. Rin is concerned at Sousuke’s nonchalant attitude toward certain things and tries to speak his mind. Meanwhile, the Iwatobi Swim Club looks toward the relay final.

11.o: The Iwatobi Swim Club continues their training. However, signs of confusion seem to keep surfacing in the silent Haruka’s swimming. Makoto and the others are worried about him, but try to continue acting cheerfully as though nothing was wrong. But one day, Sousuke appears, asking to speak to Haruka…

12.t: A Swim-Off in a Foreign Land!
12.o: Upon Rin’s invitation, Haruka finds himself venturing to “a certain country.” Knowing that Haruka has hit a wall worrying about his future, Rin opens up and speaks to him about his own thoughts and feelings. Afterward, Rin quietly asks Haruka what he will do about his own future...

13.o: Having faced his feelings honestly at last, Haruka tells Makoto, Nagisa, and Rei what he has decided for himself and his future. The Iwatobi Swim Club is once again fully united as they mount the starting block at nationals, ready to swim for themselves, for their friends, and now, for the future as well.

Haruka is later joined by Makoto, who also moved to Tokyo, at a coffee shop to catch up with Asahi... and the topic quickly turns to Ikuya, another teammate they swam with in middle school. On the day of the newcomer tournament, Haruka and Asahi are in the same race for the first time in years... and the spectacle is watched by Hiyori, who calls Haruka an "inferior copy of Ikuya." 2.t: A Promise on a Shooting Star!
2.o: Haruka and his relay teammates decide to hold a training camp in the summer of their second year of middle school. During the night, Haruka heads out to the pool and finds Ikuya looking up at the stars.

3.o: Rin, now living in Australia, trains hard every day with swimmers from all around the world. Then a Japanese guy shows up where his team is training, challenging each of his teammates to races and beating them one by one. Even Rin is surprised when this newcomer reveals his identity...

4.o: Haru, Makoto, and Asahi visit Shimogami University in hopes of talking to Ikuya, but even after looking all over campus, they can't find him. Hiyori, however, notices them and makes it his mission to keep them from seeing Ikuya.

5.o: The Iwatobi High School Swim Club is participating in a joint training camp with the Samezuka Academy and Soufuukan High School teams. Sousuke is also participating as an alumnus. In the midst of the excitement, Rei and Nagisa notice that something is odd about Romio's swimming. Then Shizuru tells them the story of what happened to Romio in middle school...

6.o: Hiyori still remembers the first time he saw Ikuya smile. Both boys grew stronger through rigorous training while they studied abroad in America... but seeing Haruka threw Ikuya off his stride. Now Hiyori wishes Ikuya would just forget about Haruka for good.

7.o: With the college championships approaching, all the swimmers are training hard on their own in addition to their official club practices. Haruka is also undergoing some extra training, with coaching from the mysterious man they've been seeing around campus. Makoto is concerned about the arrangement, but Haruka assures him that he asked for the help himself

8.o: After the breakup of his middle school swim team, Ikuya decided to get stronger on his own and not rely on anyone. But Haruka, breaking out of his freestyle comfort zone to swim in the individual medley, tells Ikuya that he's not alone.

9.o: Haruka's next race is the All-Japan Invitational, which determines who will represent Japan at the global level. To prepare for this important tournament, Haruka is invited to a special training camp.

10.o: Makoto has been unable to get in touch with Haruka following the friendly race at his training camp, making him worry that Haruka is dwelling on what happened. Then Nao approaches Makoto to tell him about a rumor he heard.

11.o: Makoto meets up with the members of the Iwatobi Swim Club who are in Tokyo for the nationals. Meanwhile, Haru continues his training.

12.o: Nagisa, Rei, and the rest of the Iwatobi Swim Club have come to cheer on their former teammates at the All-Japan Invitational. Makoto tells them the story of how ever since Haruka swam for the first time, he'd been swimming only freestyle.

1.t: The Night Flynn Sent the Cops on the Ice
1.o: In early ‘90s Boston, racism is endemic and crime is widespread. Jackie Rohr, a renowned FBI agent whose methods are not exactly by the book, does not mind the status quo. But Decourcy Ward, the new Assistant District Attorney in town, wants to uproot the corrupt system. The two form an unlikely, and obligatory, alliance to take down a gang of armored truck robbers from Charlestown.

2.t: What They Saw in Southie High
2.o: After an eventful Sunday at church, Decourcy finds out he has a new powerful enemy in town — one that puts his wife Siobhan in an awkward position. Jackie is stirring up trouble in his own home, and his distrustful mother-in-law Rosa is onto him. Investigators Hank Signa and Rachel Behnam look into an unsolved missing persons case connected to the robbery in Revere. That could mean trouble for Frankie Ryan, who's busy laundering his most recent loot and, with the help of his brother Jimmy, getting carried away in the process.

3.t: If Only the Fool Would Persist in His Folly
3.o: Jackie searches for his absent informant as Jenny searches for purpose, revisiting her passion to become a teacher. Decourcy works up a plan to overcome the town's infamous "Code of Silence" and get a few suspects to talk. Minogue is assigned a big case, but not the one he actually cares about. Jimmy skips town to visit his kids and finds that, even a thousand miles away, he's not safe from his problems back home.

4.t: The Wickedness of the Wicked Shall Be Upon Himself
4.o: Jackie strong-arms Jimmy to get a step closer to finding the presumably dead armored truck guards. Decourcy rattles a suspect called to testify before the Grand Jury. Siobhan learns something unsettling about a leader of the Coalition and worries it could jeopardize the future of the group. Kick's nightmares continue as she senses her father might be in harm's way.

5.t: From Injustice Came the Way to Describe Justice
5.o: Jackie and Decourcy continue to hunt down the weapon connected to the armored truck robbery in Revere. Michaela Freda, a local reporter, gets a tip about a story that could lead her down a treacherous path. Despite the threat of a Grand Jury, Frankie considers what he must do to provide for his family. Pressure on Siobhan begins to mount. After another allegation is brought to her attention, she questions whether doing what is right is ultimately what is for the best.

6.t: It's Hard to Be a Saint in the City
6.o: Decourcy is a step closer to connecting the stolen guns to the Revere robbery when an insider agrees to talk. Jenny is no longer able to ignore Jackie's indiscretions after they show up on her doorstep. An unexpected rush to the hospital worsens money problems for the Ryan family and Reverend Fields discovers that his longstanding influence doesn't make him invincible.

7.o: With the gang's arms dealer in custody, Jackie thinks he's a step closer to glory. But Decourcy is the one in a position to negotiate and he's considering cutting off the gun supply rather than going after the buyers. Jimmy and Frankie must find a new dealer as they prepare for their next job. Cathy and Jenny struggle to comfort their daughters who've undergone trauma. When Michaela falls into some trouble, Rachel decides to take her investigation into her own hands.

8.t: High on the Looming Gallows Tree
8.o: Jackie celebrates a win in front of the cameras but, behind closed doors, he reaches a new low. A shining moment from Decourcy promises a potential future in politics, but any pride Siobhan feels for her husband is squandered by an unexpected betrayal. The Grand Jury reconvenes, and this time Sheik doesn't get off easily. Thanks to Signa's detective work, the Ryan family is now under the watchful eye of the Suffolk DA.

9.o: When an unlikely source confides in Decourcy, the Massachusetts State Police hatch a plan that promises arrests without the help of the FBI. However, keeping out of the way is not exactly Jackie's strong suit. The Genesis Coalition pitches a new strategy to curb Boston's crime rate. Jenny opens up about her past to a sympathetic ear.

10.t: Mayor Curley and the Last Hurrah
10.o: Jackie celebrates another moment in the spotlight, though an unfamiliar pang of guilt leaves him reflecting on his legacy. Decourcy considers the best course of action to finally carry out justice for the murdered guards. Jimmy is desperate to weasel his way out of the mess he's created, even if it means putting his brother's future into question. Jenny faces what has been haunting her all these years. Season finale

1.o: When an assistant U.S. attorney overdoses and ends up left for dead, Decourcy Ward suspects Jackie Rohr's involvement. Jackie, in turn, goes after the BPD for a questionable drug arrest at Braxton Summit, a federal housing project. Community activist Grace Campbell recruits Siobhan Quays to work on behalf of Braxton and its residents, but their efforts are subverted as tensions flare between rival gangs.

2.o: As Decourcy increases pressure on the Justice Department, Jackie counters by looking into his adversary's romantic past. While Jackie's digging up dirt, Siobhan is planning ahead, focused on starting a family even as Decourcy remains preoccupied by the escalating conflict. Jenny realizes she can't keep ignoring her mother after an unsettling phone call. With business at the salon all but dead, Cathy Ryan turns to an unlikely income source.

3.t: Is the Total Black, Being Spoken
3.o: Jackie uncovers one of Decourcy's informants and hatches a plan to use him as a pawn to discredit the assistant district attorney. Decourcy stops by the Rohr house, hoping to get something out of Jenny that he can use against her husband. Siobhan receives some welcome news, in the midst of plotting her run for City Council. And her client, Kelvin Campbell, is released from custody, though he can't free himself of what happened on Valentine's Day. Jimmy Ryan, meanwhile, faces problems far worse than a guilty conscience.

4.o: After seeing Holly in the ICU, Jackie reckons with the destructive consequences of his actions, as Rickey Townsend prepares to testify against Decourcy. With violence intensifying between the Copeland Crew and the Braxton Boys, Decourcy, Anton and Siobhan face off in the interrogation room. Grace, left reflecting on her role as a mother and leader in the community, makes an unfortunate miscalculation. And back at the Rohr house, Jenny makes fast friends with the mysterious woman from Belfast.

5.o: As U.S. Attorney Karen Shimizu tries to get rid of her troublesome agent once and for all, Jackie schemes his way into a new mission. At the Suffolk County Courthouse, Decourcy and Siobhan spar on opposing sides of a legal battle. Meeting dead-ends at every turn in the effort to help her son, Grace does something desperate. With a nudge from Maeve, Jenny surprises Benny with some rebellious fun. On the other side of town, Cathy re-ups her supply by going straight to the source.

6.o: With Anton on the lam, Kelvin struggles to lead the Braxton Boys and Jackie homes in on Grace. He knows she's hiding something. Sidelined from the investigation, Decourcy finds himself at a disconnect with Siobhan, as he seeks vengeance and she focuses on recovery. When Cathy's arrangement with Isaac falls through, she pays a reluctant visit to old friends for help. Jenny, meanwhile, finally uncovers the truth about her new friend.

7.o: Assuming the involvement of the Campbell brothers at the Copeland territory shootout, Jackie confronts Grace, who can no longer sidestep her sons' criminal activity. She is forced to make a terrible compromise. Resenting the outcome of a negotiation that he could not take part in, Decourcy finds comfort in the strength of Siobhan, who keeps her head even after tragedy strikes. Jenny insists on helping Maeve, whether or not that means defying Jackie.

8.o: As Boston mourns another loss, Decourcy pursues justice in and out of the courtroom. Despite his maneuvering, Jackie discovers that he can't escape his past, while Jenny decides to finally confront hers. Cathy says goodbye to the root of her struggles. Siobhan sets her sights on a new dream.

1.o: Struggling to make ends meet after leaving the FBI, Jackie Rohr gets a job offer from his old mentor. The perks are enticing, but Jackie has no idea what he's getting himself into. ADA Decourcy Ward eyes a promotion but is diverted by some bad news which lands him back in Brooklyn. Siobhan Quays, having left her prestigious law firm for a position at the ACLU, takes on a case against a construction colossus. Jenny Rohr begins volunteering at a community center where she runs into a familiar face.

2.o: When Victoria Dryden runs away from home, Sinclair sends Jackie to find her. Caysen is after justice for BPD Officer Russ Wallace, who he believes may have been intentionally executed by another member of the Strike Force. The incident sparks a dispute at the Ward home in Brooklyn, where Decourcy is looking after his ailing father. While building a case on behalf of her impaled client, Siobhan experiences an intensifying array of symptoms. Diarmuid Doyle tries to help Jenny remedy what has been bothering her, but his plan backfires.

3.o: Vying to become Boston's next DA, Decourcy takes on a murky case involving a murdered police officer. He recruits the help of Caysen, who is becoming increasingly alienated from the officers in his unit. As the Drydens try to solve their Victoria problem, the Rohrs drop Benedetta off for her freshman year at NYU. They return empty nesters but to no peace and quiet. When Siobhan receives a distressing phone call, a dark secret resurfaces.

4.o: As Jackie continues his fling with Letitia Dryden, Jenny sets out to get her husband reinstated in the FBI. The pressure on Decourcy mounts when a colleague competing for the position of DA lands a conviction. Caysen testifies at the federal trial of Tony Suferin and is blindsided by the consequences. A threatening interaction offers Siobhan a sense of what exactly she is up against in her fight for the Mendoza family.

5.o: With the evidence against Sinclair Dryden piling up, Jackie takes action. As Decourcy fights to prove Curtis Whitaker's innocence, Caysen, who is desperate to clear his own name, entertains a compromise. Siobhan makes headway in her case against Needham Industries but is set back when a reporter comes asking questions. Jenny meets with a lawyer to discuss her father's lawsuit.

6.o: Jackie shows a glimpse of vulnerability when a violent attack stalls the Dryden investigation, but Decourcy presses on, tracking down a list of Sinclair's potential victims. Caysen is formally brought on as an investigator in the DA's office, where he must navigate competing interests. Siobhan weighs risking everything she has built to reveal the truth about her past. Jenny's suspicions are reinforced.

7.o: As Jenny grows closer to Diarmuid Doyle, her unwitting husband Jackie is released from the hospital — and he's after revenge. Siobhan calls on Decourcy for help cornering Needham Industries as she fights to expose the corporation's malfeasance. After a break in the case against Sinclair Dryden, the DA's office bumps up against an unforeseen obstacle.

8.o: As Decourcy prepares to take Sinclair Dryden to trial, despite pushback from the Suffolk County DA, Jackie tracks down a key witness. Siobhan reaches a settlement on behalf of the Mendoza family, but her moment in the spotlight is cut short. Caysen is offered a second chance by a loved one. Reckoning with the rifts in her own family, Jenny meets her long-lost half-brother. Season finale.

1.o: As the Cold War enters its final act, the CIA is sent scrambling when a rendezvous with a prized asset goes horribly awry. CIA officer Sandy Grimes begins her investigation into the source of the problem and quickly discovers that this lost asset is just the tip of the iceberg. Little does she know that this is just the beginning of a decade-long mole hunt, and the mole is one of her cohorts - Aldrich Ames.

Assigned as the lead in the debriefing, Aldrich Ames engages in a verbal cat-and-mouse game to determine whether he is in danger of being ratted out. Ames considers taking drastic measures when Yurchenko reveals that he knows of a mole in the CIA. Meanwhile, Sandy frets over the safety of a beloved and esteemed asset, General Dmitri Polyakov.

3.o: After Yurchenko's shocking disclosure, the CIA and FBI mobilize to bring the brilliant Edward Lee Howard to justice. Jeanne's presence also rattles Ames, who feels increasing pressure from the Soviets to provide more information. On the home front, Ames feels even more pressure, caught between his love for his wife Rosario, and placating her spendthrift lifestyle.

5.o: As Sandy conducts her review of the agency's spycraft, she and Jeanne continue to clash. 6.o: Having put aside their differences, Sandy and Jeanne move full steam ahead with their mole hunt. 2.o: تعثر "آمبر" و"براندي" على خاتم ألماس، وهذا يقود "آمبر" إلى الإيقان بأن أمها توشك أن تفعل شيئاً "آمبر" ليست مستعدة له.

3.o: تتخلى "آمبر" عن مخاوفها وتتقدم لتجربة أداء مسرحية المدرسة، بينما ينتقل والدها إلى شقة جديدة.

5.o: "آمبر" تريد أن تثقب أذنيها مثل "براندي"، لذا تلجأ إلى مساعدة الخالة "بام" لمحاولة إقناع أمها.

7.o: عندما تكتشف "آمبر" أن والدها كان معجباً قديماً بمعلمتها الجديدة للرياضيات، تضع خطة مع "براندي" لتتخلص من حاجتها إلى المعلمة الخاصة.

8.o: يجتاح طاقم تصوير منزل "آمبر"، وهذا له تأثير مفاجئ بجمع الأسرة معاً، وهذا يبهج "آمبر".

9.o: في أثناء تطوعها في دار للمسنين، تصادق "آمبر" مقيمة وتتحايل على قواعد المؤسسة باسم الحب والصداقة.

10.o: تتعاون الأسرة كلها لإعادة "سيسيل" خلسة إلى دار المسنين، لكن يقاطع مرحهم خبر غير متوقع.

Queen Dowager Cheonchu wishes her own son to become the next crown prince. However, Mokjong is not happy with how Kim Chi Yang, the Right Senior Executive, and Queen Dowager are trying to take over his place as he is determined to succeed the throne to King Taejo's descendant. Therefore, Mokjong is about to summon Prince Daeryangwon back to the palace, while Kim Chi Yang and Queen Dowager secretly send assassins to murder him.

2.o: Court Lady Choi threatens Prince Daeryangwon to take the food Queen Dawager has prepared for him. Prince Daeryangwon quickly runs away from the temple and hides himself in Mount Samgak. Court Lady Choi orders the men to burn down the mountain to find him. Meanwhile, Mokjong holds a banquet for his people, and Kim Chi Yang plots a crime for the night.

3.o: Kang Jo, Northwest Temporary Government Officer, sets off for Gaegyeong with a crucial mission. However, deep within his thoughts, he grapples with the realization that Goryeo's very existence is at stake if the current state of ruling persists. Meanwhile, in another part of the kingdom, Prince Daeryangwon anxiously awaits assistance from His Majesty. To his surprise, he finds himself confronted with an entirely new chapter of life, carefully orchestrated for him.

4.o: Caught in the crossfire between those gearing up for war and those working to prevent it, the puppet king, Wang Sun, and Kang Gam Chan form the front line of those seeking to avert conflict. On the opposing side, Kang Jo believes in the inevitability of war and sees it as a chance to eradicate the Khitans. The turning point comes when envoys from Khitan arrive with a message poised to alter the course of history.

5.o: The ministers struggle to dissuade the Khitan envoys as Prince Daeryangwon expected. He believes that Khitan is using the Palace Head Secretary's treason to justify the war. Therefore, Prince Daeryangwon summons Kang Jo alone to his chamber at night to get rid of him.

6.o:
Details

The battle between Goryeo and Khitan begins in the middle of the night, and the people of Goryeo shiver with fear. With 400,000 soldiers, Khitan attacks Heunghwajin for seven days straight, but they are unable to destroy the fortress. Therefore, they come up with another strategy. Meanwhile, Prince Daeryangwon visits the temple where people are gathered to pray.

7.o: The Emperor of Khitan is infuriated as he loses the first conquest expedition he is leading. He starts advancing south with his army towards Samsuchae to destroy Goryeo's main force. Therefore, even though Officer Yang manages to defeat Khitan soldiers, the main force assumes Heunghwajin has lost the battle as they are trapped. Officer Yang must find a way to send the word.

8.o: The spearhead commander of the Khitan army launches an attack and captures Kang Jo. The emperor of Khitan threatens Kang Jo and the captured generals to become vassals of Khitan. Meanwhile, Hyeonjong receives the news that the Goryeo army was defeated, and Deputy Minister Kang advises him not to share the news with the people.

9.o: Hyeonjong sends Deputy Minister Kang to Khitan's camp as an envoy to relay his message. However, the commander of Khitan's army does not trust his words and decides to hold him back in their camp. Furthermore, Deputy Mayor Won of Seogyeong Fortress gives up on fighting against Khitan and is about to surrender.

11.o: As the Khitans advance southward, Kang Gam Chan urges Wang Sun to consider a strategic withdrawal for a greater purpose. Wang Sun's unwavering loyalty to his people clashes with the stark reality of limited options. With Gaegyeong in the crosshairs, Wang Sun stands on the precipice of a crucial decision.

12.o: Kang Gam Chan makes a critical decision to stay back in Gaegyeong, sacrificing himself to create a window for Wang Sun's escape. Despite Kang Gam Chan's noble sacrifice, Wang Sun encounters unforeseen dangers at every step of his journey. Meanwhile, Yang Kyu is devising a plan to reclaim Gwakju, the current base of the Khitan army.

13.o: The realization of the hardships encountered by those south of Gaegyeong leaves Wang Sun with a sense of emptiness. The difficulties they face highlight his shortcomings as a king, evoking a deep sense of disappointment in himself. Meanwhile, Kang Gam Chan finds himself in captivity as he attempts to secretly rendezvous with Xiao Paiya.

14.o: As his people turn against him, Wang Sun bears the weight of shame for not living up to their expectations as their emperor. Entrusting them with his fate, he seeks to ease the suffering of his people. Ha Gong Jin, following Kang Gam Chan’s plans, heads toward the heart of the Khitan army with a diplomatic letter.

15.o: Upon reaching Gongju, Wang Sun receives a warm welcome from Kim Eun Boo, the governor, and one of his daughters. Wang Sun discerns a hidden agenda in the daughter's intentions but soon recognizes her potential as someone crucial for Goryeo in these challenging times. The Khitan army begins withdrawing from Gaegyeong, prompting Yang Kyu to seize the moment and launch an attack.

16.o: Yang Kyu throws himself into the Khitan army to rescue prisoners, fully aware that this might be his last battle. As expected, he and the remnants of his forces find themselves pitted against the Khitan army in overwhelming numbers. Meanwhile, Wang Sun receives news of the Khitan army's retreat and hurries back to Gaegyeong. Witnessing the state of Gaegyeong, he falls to his knees in despair.

17.o: In the face of opposition, Wang Sun remains unwavering in his commitment to overhaul the core issues haunting Goryeo, aiming to fortify the nation and spare his people from the ravages of war. Nevertheless, dissenters argue that certain priorities must be addressed before delving into Wang Sun's proposed changes. Meanwhile, the Khitans are gearing up for another confrontation with Goryeo.

18.o: In the face of strong opposition, Wang Sun persists in pursuing his goals, alongside Kim Eun Boo. Kang Gam Chan, while sharing Wang Sun's ultimate objective, disagrees with his approach and goes to great lengths to persuade him otherwise. Eventually, Wang Sun remains unwavering in his convictions and removes Kang Gam Chan from his position. To curb Kim Eun Boo's influence on Wang Sun, Kang Gam Chan implements assertive actions.

19.o: The queen consort seeks to punish Kim Eun-bu while the king is away from the palace. But guilt leads Kang Gam-chan to attempt to spare the commander.

20.o: With Kang Gam-chan's help, Wang Sun succeeds in launching reforms. However, the local governance is unhappy, and Kang Gam-chan faces the consequences.

21.o: Wang Sun puts his life on the line during an intense confrontation with regional lords to bring about reform in Goryeo's regional domain. With Kang Gam Chan's return to the royal court, Wang Sun secures a reliable ally. Concurrently, the Khitans exert pressure on Wang Sun to fulfill the homage promised during the recent war.

22.o: The Khitans demand that Goryeo cede its territories to prevent another war, turning a tribute issue into a crucial decision for Goryeo. With time running out, conflicting opinions emerge, and amidst this urgency, Kim Eun Boo takes a perilous gamble for a daring escape.

23.o: Wang Sun prepares for battle while Kim Eun Boo, risking his life, attempts to provide Wang Sun with updates on the Khitans' situation. Meanwhile, during this critical moment, military officials in Goryeo decide to oppose Wang Sun's orders, insisting on the restoration of their rightful authority. Kang Gam Chan departs for Heunghwajin with the orders issued by Wang Sun.

24.o: On the edge of the northeastern border and lacking battlefield expertise, Kang Gam Chan encounters a looming confrontation with the unyielding Jurchens. Meanwhile, Wang Sun overlooks the insubordination displayed by military officials, while the brewing anger and rage inside Kim Hoon and Choi Jil persist.

25.o: Amidst Goryeo's financial struggles, Kim Hoon and Choi Jil launch a rebellion, citing the seizure of military officers’ properties as their justification. Wang Sun, lacking sufficient guards for protection, finds himself surrounded by his own forces. Meanwhile, border troops mobilize toward Gaegyeong to aid Wang Sun.

26.o: Kim Hoon and Choi Jil threaten the lives of Wang Sun's vassals, compelling him to order the soldiers heading to Gaegyeong to retreat. With circumstances turning against Wang Sun, he faces a dilemma, torn between doing what is right and safeguarding his innocent vassals. Meanwhile, Kang Gam Chan and other vassals operate in the shadows, clandestinely searching for the mastermind behind the rebellion.

27.o: Wang Sun successfully pursues and apprehends Park Jin, but he is constrained by his own lack of authority. He subsequently seeks to persuade Kim Hoon, who is engaged in a dispute with Choi Jil, to quell the uprising. Meanwhile, a second envoy from Khitan returns to Goryeo, demanding that the King of Goryeo pay tribute to prevent hostilities.

28.o: The vassals, having received Wang Sun's directives, ready themselves to suppress the rebels at Seogyeong. Although Wang Sun, accompanied by the rebels, eventually reaches Seogyeong, those expected to execute his commands are conspicuously absent. Nevertheless, there may be an undisclosed scheme underway to prevent Wang Sun from crossing the Yalu River.

29.o: Wang Sun eradicates the rebel faction and prepares for war against the Khitans. In 1018, the final and decisive battle between Goryeo and the Khitans draws near. With Kang Gam Chan leading the Goryeo army as its commander, they embark on their journey toward the ultimate confrontation.

30.o: The Khitan Army's maneuvers raise suspicion as they actively evade engaging with the Goryeo forces and persistently advance solely southward. Recognizing their strategic intent, Kang Gam Chan advises Wang Sun to consider seeking refuge, but Wang Sun adamantly issues strict orders to defend Gaegyeong.

31.o: Accompanied by his remaining soldiers, vassals, and the people of Goryeo, Wang Sun ventures beyond the fortress boundaries with the intention of minimizing the suffering of his people. Meanwhile, Kang Gam Chan clashes with the retreating Khitan forces on the plains of Kwiju, marking the onset of the war.

32.o: The culmination of the war sees Goryeo emerging triumphant over the Khitans. Kang Gam Chan's return is a scene of jubilation, with the citizens of Gaegyeong celebrating his victory. Yet, Wang Sun, undeterred by the momentary glory, devises a plan aimed at ensuring enduring tranquility in Goryeo.

تشعر "فيكي" التي تخطو على أعتاب أزمة منتصف العمر بالغيرة من رؤية صديقاتها يعشن علاقات غرامية، وتخرج عن السيطرة عندما تكتشف أنّ حبيبها السابق قد تزوج.

2.o: تتحول رحلة الفتيات إلى حمل ثقيل على "فيكي" حين تعلن "ديبورا" عن خبر سارّ، وتحظى "فيكي" بمهرب هي في أشد الحاجة إليه عندما تتلقى رسالة نصية من "نيكولاس" مع بلوغها الأربعين.

3.o: رغم إصابتها بحساسية محرجة، تبحث "فيكي" بجدية مفرطة عن رفيق تصطحبه معها إلى حفل زفاف صديقتها... وهل هناك طريقة أفضل من تطبيقات المواعدة للعثور على مطلبها؟

4.t: A Lioness but Not a Champion
4.ar: شخصية قوية لكنها لم تكن بطلة
4.o: تعثر "فيكي" على رفيق تصطحبه معها إلى زفاف "ميلي"، حيث تتسبب زلة لسان في إنهاء الحفل بشكل مفاجئ. وأثناء ذلك، تنمو مشاعر "ماتياس" تجاه "فيكي".

5.o: خلال رحلة تضم "فيكي" و"كارو" ووالدتهما "تيري"، يتكشّف خبر صادم يغيّر كل شيء. وتبدأ "ديبورا" بالتخطيط لزفافها.

6.o: تسيطر الغيرة على "فيكي" بسبب الصداقة التي تجمع بين "ماغي" و"نيكو"، ويعاني "ماتياس" من مشاعره تجاه "فيكي"، وتتخذ "كارو" قرارًا من شأنه أن يغيّر حياتها.

7.o: تنظم صديقات "فيكي" جلسة تدخّل لمناقشة غيرتها وإفسادها حياة الآخرين، بينما يواجه "ماتياس" والده ويتواصل "دانييل" مع "فيكي".

8.o: عندما تخبر "فيكي" و"كارو" والدتهما بالعثور على والدهما "هيكتور"، تفجّر "تيري" مفاجأة كبيرة. وتتحدث "فيكي" بصراحة مع "نيكولاس" حول احتياجاتها.

9.o: تكتشف "كارو" حقيقة مؤلمة تفوق احتمالها، وتؤدي معرفة "فيكي" بتفاصيل جديدة حول "نيكو" إلى تقويض ثقتها في نفسها.

10.o: يظهر الجانب التنافسي في شخصية "فيكي" خلال جلسة علاج نفسي قوية، وتتملك "ديبورا" مشاعر الرهبة في يوم زفافها، وتواجه "لوسيلا" وجميع الضيوف حالة من الصدمة.

11.o: يظهر وجه جديد وخبر يكسر قلب "فيكي" في أحد الاحتفالات بنجاح الوكالة، ويضع "ماتياس" مسافة بينه وبين "فيكي" بعد تقرّبه من "ماي".

12.o: تتلقى "فيكي" المصابة مساعدة من صديق بمعنى الكلمة ويجمعها لقاء مؤثر بوالدها، ويتنافس "دانييل" و"ماتياس" على قلب "فيكي".

1.o: توشك أحلام "فيكي" أن تتحقق، لكن نوبة ذعر تجعلها تفكر في ما تريده... ومَن ترغب فيه حقًا؟

2.o: تعيد "فيكي" النظر في معاملتها لـ"ماتياس" بعدما تحرّك مواجهة مع "نيكو" مشاعر صعبة. ومن ناحية أخرى، تخضع "كارو" إلى فحص الموجات فوق الصوتية.

3.o: وسط معاناتها من عدم فهم مشاعرها المتضاربة، تجد "فيكي" نفسها في حالة من الحيرة بعد دعوة "ماتياس" لها. ويكتشف "ماتياس" شيئًا حول "ماي".

4.o: تقلب مصادفة مفاجئة مع "ديبي" رحلة "فيكي" و"دانييل" الرومانسية رأسًا على عقب، ويتخذ "ماتياس" خطوة إلى الأمام في علاقته بـ"ماي".

5.o: تحاول "فيكي" أن تعيش حياتها كامرأة عزباء. ولكن عندما يجمعها لقاء بـ"ماتياس" أثناء سهرة مع صديقاتها، تجد صعوبة في السيطرة على مشاعرها العاطفية المدفونة نحوه.

6.o: تعيش "فيكي" لحظة محرجة في الصباح التالي لليلة قضتها مع "ماتياس" وتتركها في حالة ارتباك أكثر من أي وقت مضى. وتزيد نتيجة التقييم للعمل من حدة الأمور وتشعرها بعدم الاستقرار.

7.o: خلال زيارتها لـ"كارو"، تضطر "فيكي" إلى مواجهة انتكاساتها الخاصة. ويحاول "ماتياس" تنظيم حفل عيد ميلاد مفاجئ من أجل "ماي".

8.o: تتخذ "فيكي" موقفًا بعدما يطلب منها "ماتياس" بعض المساحة. وتدرك "فيكي" أمرًا مهمًا خلال زيارة إلى المستشفى، بينما تثير علاقة "ميلي" العاطفية الجديدة هجومًا إعلاميًا.

9.o: بعد محادثتها مع "دانييل"، تشعر "فيكي" بالصدمة وتدرك أنها تحصد ما زرعته. أمّا "ماي"، فتسأل "ماتياس" عن مشاعره تجاه "فيكي".

10.o: يحاول "ماتياس" أن يكون صريحًا مع "ماي"، بينما تحظى "فيكي" و"كارو" وبعض الصديقات بلقاء مثير للفضول مع مدربة أمومة، وتنال "كارو" نصيبها بعد يوم مليء بالضغوط.

11.o: تجلب لحظة مهمة مشاعر البهجة والذعر، ويخوض "ماتياس" و"ماي" حديثًا من القلب. وبينما تخيم الشكوك على حياة "فيكي"، هل ستفتح المجال أمام "ماتياس" قبل فوات الأوان؟

1.o: لن تمنع الامتحانات والكوابيس وجلسات العلاج النفسي "فيكي" من الانغماس في علاقتها مع "ماتياس"... حتى وإن لم يعلن عنها في حسابه على "الإنستغرام" بعد.

2.o: تزداد غيرة "فيكي" من عمل "ماتياس" الجديد وزميلة له هناك، فيما تُمنى مقابلة توظيف لها بالفشل. ومن جهة أخرى، توشك مسؤوليات الأمومة على أن ترهق "كارو" تمامًا.

3.o: يتحوّل عشاء يجمع الثنائيين "لولا" و"فيليبي" و"ماتياس" و"فيكي" إلى ساحة منافسة. وعلى صعيد آخر، يتزايد قلق "كارو" إلى مستويات عالية حين تعترف بسرّ دفين لصديقتيها.

4.o: تذهب "فيكي" و"ماتياس" في عطلة رومانسية، لكنها سرعان ما تتحوّل إلى كارثة. وبينما تفجّر "كارو" مفاجأة في وجه "فيرمين"، تتسبب جلسة علاجية في انكسار قلب أحدهم.

5.o: تُخفي "كارو" سرًّا عن "فيكي"، التي تبحث عن طبيب نفسي جديد. وفي سياق آخر، تتحوّل سهرة تقضيها الصديقات إلى شجار حاد بين الشقيقتين.

6.o: بينما تعاني "لو" من خيانة زوجها لها، ينشغل بال "فيكي" برحلة عمل يذهب فيها "ماتياس" برفقة "لولا". من جهتها، تحاول "كارو" أن تُهدِّئ الأمور بين الجميع.

7.o: مع وصولها إلى "كاسكاديتا"، تشكّك "فيكي" في ما إذا كان تعقبها لـ"ماتياس" هو القرار السليم. ومن جهة أخرى، يكشف اتصال هاتفي أمرًا يجعل "كارو" تصاب بصدمة من "فيكي" و"لو".

8.o: تلوح فرصة جديدة أمام "فيكي" أثناء مجالستها لـ"إيما"، فيما تدور بين "كارو" و"فيرمين" محادثة صعبة. أما "فيكي" و"ماتياس"، فتتدهور علاقتهما.

9.o: تصاب "كارو" بصدمة مروّعة من "فيرمين"، فيما تعود المياه إلى مجاريها بين "فيكي" و"ماتياس". لكن، هل لا تزال "فيكي" موافقة على خطتهما المستقبلية لإنجاب طفل؟

10.o: تتوصل "فيكي" إلى حقيقة صعبة بعد جلسة طارئة مع "فيرناندا". أما "ماتياس"، فيحظى بزيارة مفاجئة تضع مستقبله مع "فيكي" على المحك.

1.o: مع ظهور "برونو" في الصورة، تجد "فيكي" أن إرضاء فتًى في التاسعة من عمره أمر شبه مستحيل. وبسبب تأثير "نورا" عليها، تتخذ قرارًا وتنفذه في الحال.

2.o: يتسبب واقع "برونو" في دفع "فيكي" لمواجهة مخاوف من نوع مختلف. وبينما تتأقلم هي و"ماتياس" مع حياتهما الجديدة معًا، يداهمهما تغيير آخر.

3.o: تفجّر "تيريسا" مفاجأة، مدوّية، وتشعر "كارو" بالشوق إلى "فيرمين". وبينما هي عازمة على كسب عميل جديد، تتعرض "فيكي" لصدمة وتنتابها الحيرة عندما يصل آخر شخص كانت تتوقعه.

4.o: يثير اقتحام "فيكي" رحلة تخييم "ماتياس" و"برونو" نتائج متباينة. وفي لحظة فارقة في حياة ابنتها، تشتعل شخصية الأم المديرة التي تكمن داخل "لو".

5.o: تتحول حصة لصناعة مشغولات فخارية إلى مهمة استطلاع لـ"فيكي" و"كارو"، وتتسبب محادثة صادقة في صدمة عاطفية تؤلم قلب "كارو"، بينما تجمع "فيكي" معلومات شديدة الوقع.

6.o: يحضر ضيف مفاجئ جلسة العلاج النفسي لـ"فيكي"، وتثير أجواء الزفاف شكوك "فيكي" و"كارو"، بينما ينقذ "ماتياس" الخطاب المرتجل الذي يُلقى أثناء الزفاف.

7.o: تجد "فيكي" نفسها في موقف حرج بسبب يوم قضته مع "نيكولاس"، لكن عرضًا فنيًا لمرحلة ما قبل المدرسة يفتح المجال لمواجهة مؤثرة. أما "كارو" و"فيرمين"، فلم يعد بالإمكان الهروب من مشاعرهما.

8.o: يتسبب حلم في إرباك "فيكي" قبل رحلة عمل مهمة، وإن كانت محل شك. ويبدأ مخاض "ليني"، بينما تثير مكالمة هاتفية مخاوف "فيكي".

9.o: تضع "كارو" حدودًا في علاقتها مع "فيرمين". وتتحول مباراة بولينغ إلى فوز محقق لـ"برونو" و"فيكي"، لكن لحظة ثقة تهدد بتعرض "فيكي" لانتكاسة.

10.o: بينما يستعدّ "برونو" لمعرض مهم، تواجه "فيكي" الضغوط الحقيقية للأمومة، في حين تبدأ "كارو" و"فيرمين" صفحة جديدة في حياتهما.

4.o: Michael and Kristine's marriage reaches a breaking point as their differing perspectives on Natalia threaten to tear them apart. When the stakes become dangerous, Kristine draws a line.

6.o: Natalia questions whether she can trust an unexpected set of allies. As questions about her past arise, painful memories are unearthed.

7.t: If You Tell a Story Well Enough
7.o: Just as the Barnetts think they've distanced themselves from Natalia, Detective Drysdale takes up her case to challenge her re-aging.

8.o: With the world watching, Natalia and the Barnetts face off in the court of law and the court of public opinion.

4.o: تتعقب المجموعة عملية التخلص من الجثث ضمن خطة لكشف منظم "كودوكو". وهناك يتواجه "شوجيرو" مع "ساكورا"، وهو رفيق سابق من مقاطعة "ساتسوما".

5.o: مع انكشاف الهدف الحقيقي لبطولة "كودوكو"، يرسل "شوجيرو" برقية لتحذير "أوكوبو" من المؤامرة المتفاقمة ويتخذ التدابير اللازمة للحفاظ على سلامة "فوتابا".

6.o: مع وقوع "إروها" أخيرًا تحت حصار "غينتوساي" الذي لا يعرف الرحمة، يلتقي "شوجيرو" بـ"بوكوتسو" في مواجهة نهائية شرسة، ويقترب "أوكوبو" من الوصول إلى العقل المدبّر للعبة.

2.t: Mother's Death and the Evil Deeds of the Ilseongpa

Searching for clues, she finds an SOS from Mi Yang and chases a mysterious woman. As secrets unravel, So Min learns that Mi Yang's voice is being exploited by a phishing ring. Consumed by grief and rage, she vows revenge, joining forces with Detective Park Jeong Hun and turning to deepfake herself for a strike.

3.t: Somin's camouflage, the beginning of infiltration

Sensing that Jung-hoon will return to his police status and intervene, he confesses lies to President Kim and makes a new proposal.

4.t: The beginning of a game of deception and deception

8.t: The End of the Ilseong Faction and the Liberation of the Common People
